### Counter-proofs

- "Do only the check-in": the in-care hub withholds a number while the latest facility letter's contact is not a recorded check-in; the profile has none, so a check-in confirmed now carries no valid number under the visible rule.
- Closest alternative start date 2026-01-29 (admission) is excluded by `absence_start_date_determination_c70c2079` §2 with all four limits met; the receipt date 02-09 is excluded by §1 ("never the date the accepted notice was received").
- Recording the April letter too: no visible rule asks for it; the prerequisite names only "the most recently received accepted facility letter", and the facility number reads "the letter read is the one received most recently".
- Reclassifying to Non-Borrowing Spouse / other plans: no NBS, no trust, no representative on the loan record; the reclassification setting for Joint Borrower names Standard Annual.
- Fall-back numbers (written down): W1 0, W2 2026-01-29, W3 1, W4 4 — each definite and different from the derived value.
- Factor findability from record words: "death notice" (report, settling, contact-interval, re-dating anchor), "HECM … scheduled monthly payments" (contact interval, call-in interval), "co-borrower" + HECM loan (co-borrower allowance, transfer window), "rejected health-care absence notice … signer not required" (departure date, transfer window), "supporting document"/"letter" (facility-letter allowance, corroboration window, earlier-letter numbers, standing date), "inspection result occupied by the borrower" (overdue-cycle allowance, inspection number), "check-in … cites a supporting document" (numbering basis, late-contact grace, early-answer allowance).
